units.source_text: 三十个客人，只有三个人陪。

en.t: There are thirty guests, and only three women to attend to them.

units.source_text: 她们又是一老一少，我可够呛哩。

en.t: And since the other two are one old woman and one young girl, it is especially hard on me.

units.source_text: 那些客人太小气了，一定是什么旅行团体。

en.t: Those guests are far too stingy; they must be some kind of tour group.

units.source_text: 三十人嘛，至少要有六个人陪才是。

en.t: For thirty people, there ought to be at least six attendants.

units.source_text: 我现在去，喝几杯吓唬吓唬他们。”

en.t: I am going now to have a few drinks and give them a scare.
